end.summary:
- Practised observing and describing bird beaks and feet.
- Described a long, pointy beak and considered webbed feet.
- Linked webbed feet to moving in water and a beak to catching fish.
- Identified that a bird catches fish from water.
- Teach-back was not passed; observation descriptions were not independently correct in the recorded attempt.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised looking closely at beak and foot features and linking them to how a bird moves and what it eats. They used the method of connecting webbed feet with movement in water and a beak with catching fish. They mixed up some feature descriptions and needed prompts; the later response correctly identified fish as the food caught from water. At home, look at one bird or plant together and record two visible features and what each might help it do.
